# AI Design Skills [![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/elayadesign/ai-design-skills)](https://skills.sh/elayadesign/ai-design-skills) A growing collection of design skills for AI coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and anything else that reads a markdown rules file. Each skill is a self-contained folder. Install the ones you need. --- ## Skills | Skill | What it does | |---|---| | [`landing-page-design`](./skills/landing-page-design/SKILL.md) | Builds a landing page from scratch — intake questions, page structure, conversion copy, plus a full visual system (type, spacing, radius, motion) | | [`figma-designer`](./skills/figma-designer/SKILL.md) | Designs inside Figma with real structure: spacing, radius and color variables, named text styles, auto layout, components with every state, and a Foundations frame that updates with the tokens | More on the way. [Upgrading an existing site instead of building new?](https://github.com/elayadesign/redesign-skill) That one lives in its own repo since it predates this collection. --- ## Install Uses the [skills CLI](https://skills.sh). Needs Node.js. ```bash npx skills add elayadesign/ai-design-skills ``` It lists the skills in this repo and asks which ones to install and for which agents. Add flags to skip the prompts: ```bash # one skill npx skills add elayadesign/ai-design-skills --skill landing-page-design # pick agents npx skills add elayadesign/ai-design-skills -a claude-code -a cursor # user-level instead of project-level npx skills add elayadesign/ai-design-skills -g # see what's available without installing npx skills add elayadesign/ai-design-skills --list ``` Add `-y` to skip confirmations. Skills land in `.claude/skills/` for Claude Code and `.agents/skills/` for Cursor, Codex and other agents. Run `npx skills update` later to pull changes. Then just ask, in plain language, for what the skill covers.
Manual install Claude Code: ```bash mkdir -p .claude/skills git clone https://github.com/elayadesign/ai-design-skills.git /tmp/ai-design-skills cp -r /tmp/ai-design-skills/skills/ .claude/skills/ ``` Cursor: ```bash mkdir -p .cursor/rules curl -o .cursor/rules/.md \ https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elayadesign/ai-design-skills/main/skills//SKILL.md ``` Or paste the file into **Settings → Rules for AI**. Codex, Windsurf, other: copy the skill's `SKILL.md` into your tool's rules file. | Tool | Path | |---|---| | Codex | `AGENTS.md` | | Windsurf | `.windsurfrules` | | Cline | `.clinerules` | | Generic | paste into your system prompt |
Claude.ai (no terminal) Download the skill's `SKILL.md` and upload it to a Project, or attach it to a chat and say *"follow this."*
--- ## Make it yours Every skill's design values (fonts, colors, spacing, motion) live in one section near the bottom of its file. Fork this repo, edit that section, and the rest of the skill follows automatically. --- ## Credits `landing-page-design` adapts content realism and motion ideas from [Leonxlnx/taste-skill](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill) by Leon Lin, MIT licensed. Details are at the end of [its SKILL.md](./skills/landing-page-design/SKILL.md#credits). --- ## License MIT. Use it, fork it, ship it, sell what you build with it. No attribution needed.
